recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to Event-pattern semantics or performer actor types should be handled under their own Jira issues, not by reopening FHIR-13841.
issue_request: FHIR-13841 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 AuditEvent change request asking the Security work group to align AuditEvent with the new Event pattern. The final resolution was to do mapping to Event, with WG discussion noting that full structural alignment was inappropriate for lifecycle status and subject semantics.
initial_application: The 2018-03-01 GF#13841 commit 7b2b64512052c9a800a59b0ac3cd2cd013659b1b added a Workflow Mapping column to the AuditEvent spreadsheet and mapped AuditEvent to Event plus selected AuditEvent elements to Event paths. It mapped AuditEvent.agent to Event.performer and related sub-elements instead of renaming the live element.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source preserves Event mappings for the root and relevant elements, including type/category, subtype/code, occurred/occurrence, authorization/reason, basedOn, patient/subject, encounter, agent/performer, agent.type/performer.function, agent.who/performer.actor, and agent.location/location. Later FHIR-28100 and FHIR-38871 work added Event-pattern basedOn/encounter context and mapping-exception tooling, and the current AuditEvent Event mapping-exceptions file records the optional patient/subject and no lifecycle-status divergences.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already implements the FHIR-13841 decision and explains the non-alignments that should remain.

related_jiras.note: Added AuditEvent basedOn and encounter following the Event pattern, complementing the earlier mapping-only alignment.
Required pattern mapping gaps and divergences to be surfaced or explained; current AuditEvent mapping-exceptions source satisfies that context.
Later R6 Event performer actor clarification touched AuditEvent agent.who target types, but it is a separate Resolved-change-required issue and not needed to decide this seed.
